subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently remove `antml:`/`mm:`-qualified or `<function_calls>`-wrapped invoke XML from persisted `done.message`, rather than only suppressing it in user-visible delivery?
rationale: The code distinguishes bare examples and has focused proof, but deciding whether qualified XML is categorically invalid durable assistant content is a product and transcript-retention policy choice that source review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Confirm qualified transcript redaction
options.body: Treat the provider-qualified and wrapper-qualified forms as malformed tool-call artifacts and merge the current delivery-plus-persistence scrub.

options.title: Restrict removal to delivery
options.body: Hide the malformed XML from channel replies while retaining it in durable history until a broader transcript-redaction policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Confirm qualified transcript redaction
recommendation.body: Treat the provider-qualified and wrapper-qualified forms as malformed tool-call artifacts and merge the current delivery-plus-persistence scrub.

likelyOwner.reason: The direct contributor can explain the narrowed qualification boundary, though a current agent/runtime owner should make the final policy call.
